scope: Exact active completion and final-output drain
rules: Completion requires the exact pending submitted capability and the exact active relay call, matching actual immutable parent/native/worker/attempt/host/configuration/model/effort and terminal succeeded observation.
Foreign, stale, repeated and uncertain completion cannot reset the shorter watchdog deadline.
Drain actual final native output nonblockingly within a fixed grace capped by original host and invocation deadlines; no completion success from exit alone.
Real-child fixture controls event ordering without account/model/provider operations or normal profile changes.
